label: exploratory development analysis (outcomes previously viewed)

sign_dictionary.G: Y_BQ - Y_QQ = A + I (replace the current action only)
sign_dictionary.H: Y_QB - Y_QQ = C + I (keep Q's action, BF16 suffix)
sign_dictionary.F: Y_BB - Y_QQ = A + C + I (BF16 action and suffix)
sign_dictionary.strict_reversal: (Y_BB - Y_QB)(Y_BQ - Y_QQ) < 0, i.e. A*G < 0 (patterns 0110, 1001); reported apart from I != 0
sign_dictionary.no_divergence: no eligible divergence = the primary pivot policy does nothing: G, r, d, M, H_policy, F_policy = 0 (effect_source no_intervention); raw Y_BB/Y_BQ/Y_QB, A, C, I, H, F and the 16-pattern are null, so A/C/I/H/F are reported only on observed divergent states
sign_dictionary.change_vs_W63: names G/H/F per the plan (H was QB_minus_QQ, F was BB_minus_QQ); full-pool A/C/I and full-pool H/F as if no-divergence units had four equal outcomes are withdrawn; H/F on the full pool are now the explicit pivot policies H_policy/F_policy (switch at the pivot, do nothing without one)
